Meta.title: Medinaa — Madagascar's healthcare directory
Meta.description: Madagascar's healthcare directory — free and geolocated: hospitals, pharmacies, doctors, health posts and CSBs on one map.
Meta.tagline: All of Madagascar's healthcare, on one map.

Hero.title: Find the care you need, wherever you are in Madagascar.
Hero.subtitle: Hospitals, pharmacies, doctors, health posts, CSBs… {count}+ geolocated facilities, for free. On the web and on Android.

Features.title: Why Medinaa
Features.searchBody: Filter by type: hospital, pharmacy, doctor, health post, CSB…
Features.nearMeBody: Geolocate the nearest facilities with one tap.
Features.mapBody: Explore all of Madagascar on a smooth map.
Features.detailsBody: Phone number, opening hours, address and OpenStreetMap link.
Features.routeBody: Calculate your route with a customizable starting point.
Features.i18nBody: Available in French, Malagasy and English.

How.step3Body: Call the facility or get directions.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.a1: Yes, Medinaa is 100% free and requires no account.
Faq.q2: Where does the data come from?
Faq.a2: The data comes from OpenStreetMap, an open and collaborative mapping database.
Faq.a3: For now the native app is on Android only. On iPhone, use the web app which works in the browser.
Faq.q4: How do I report an error on a facility?
Faq.a4: You can contribute directly on OpenStreetMap or contact us.
Faq.q5: What is the difference between the web app and the mobile app?
Faq.a5: The web app works everywhere without installation; the Android app offers a native experience (geolocation, offline, notifications).

Footer.privacyNotice: Medinaa uses internal audience measurement, without cookies or third-party trackers, to improve the service.
